name: Elix Custom Fields and Post Types
author: Elix Apps

sections.description:
Elix Custom Fields and Post Types gives you complete control over your WordPress edit screens and custom data.

Core Features

  • Lightweight & High Performance: Clean architecture with low memory footprint and optimized caching.
  • Intuitive Field Builder: Fast, responsive field group builder with live configuration.
  • 14 Built-in Field Types: Text, Textarea, Number, Email, Password, URL, Select, Checkbox, Radio, True/False, Date, Time, DateTime, and Color Picker.
  • Smart Location Rules: Display field groups based on post types, specific posts, pages, page templates, post statuses, or user roles.
  • Developer Friendly API: Clean functions including ecfpt_the_field(), ecfpt_get_field(), ecfpt(), elix_the_field(), and ecf_the_field().
  • Export & Import: One-click JSON export and import for transferring field groups across environments.
  • REST API Support: Clean REST API endpoints for headless and decoupled WordPress sites.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the elix-custom-fields-and-post-types folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory, or install directly through the WordPress plugins screen.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress.
  3. Navigate to Elix Fields in the admin sidebar to start creating field groups.

Does this plugin work with Gutenberg (Block Editor)?

Yes! Custom field groups are compatible with both the Gutenberg block editor and the Classic editor.

Are custom field values preserved upon plugin deactivation?

Yes. Field group definitions and post metadata remain stored in your database.

1.0.0

  • Initial public release on WordPress.org.
  • Core field group builder with 14 foundational field types.
  • Location rules engine for posts, pages, templates, statuses, and user roles.
  • High-performance MetaManager caching engine.
  • JSON import/export tool for seamless field group migration.
